problem_statement.summary: Condition API/verifier/BoolRecipe are symmetric, but If/Loop handlers still parse raw Compare locally and diverge.
observed_asymmetry: IfStmtHandler accepts only Var == Int and does not attach cond_recipe
LoopStmtHandler attaches top-level cond_recipe manually instead of using constructor
Loop nested If items use legacy cond_facts only and require Var < Int
Rust loop_condition_shape misses Eq/Ne even though generic_loop_canon and BoolRecipe support six comparison operators

selected_sequence.role: Add shared ProgramJSON Var op Int compare reader; reader-only, no consumers changed.
Attach cond_recipe to existing If Var == Int rows while preserving legacy cond_facts and behavior.
Add one user-visible non-Eq If condition row through the shared reader.
Attach cond_recipe to Loop-body nested If items through the same shared reader.
Switch top-level Loop cond_recipe attachment to loop_item_with_cond_recipe without behavior change.
Add Eq/Ne to Rust loop_condition_shape numeric compare canon without AST rewrite.
Consult whether If conditions should enter CondProfile/CondSkeleton or remain BoolRecipe-side only for now.
